scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @portfolio/contracts build && concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web -c auto "pnpm --filter @portfolio/contracts dev" "pnpm --filter @portfolio/api dev" "pnpm --filter @portfolio/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @portfolio/contracts build && pnpm --filter @portfolio/api build && pnpm --filter @portfolio/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @portfolio/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @portfolio/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @portfolio/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @portfolio/contracts build && pnpm --filter @portfolio/api test && pnpm --filter @portfolio/web test
scripts.check: pnpm audit:architecture && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
